Contact

Last updated September 21, 2026. Dressmaker is a fan-made guide and is not affiliated with the developers.

The fastest way to reach the person who runs this site is email.

Email

hello@dressmakerguide.com

We read everything. We answer most things within a few days, and we answer corrections faster than anything else because a wrong fact on a guide page costs readers real money or real time.

What to write to us about

  • A correction. A price, a date, a spec or a patch note that is wrong or out of date. If you can, include the page URL and the official source that contradicts us.
  • A broken link. Download links and store links rot faster than anything else on a game site.
  • Something you found in the game that we have not covered. A fabric behaviour worth adding to the wiki, a customer pattern worth writing up on the customers page, or a trick that saved you a bolt of silk.
  • A question about the game. We answer guide questions by email and, when a question comes up repeatedly, we turn it into a section on the how to play or troubleshooting page.
  • A privacy or legal request. See the privacy policy for what we can and cannot do.

What we cannot help with

  • Game support and refunds. We are not the developers. Bugs, crashes, lost saves and Steam refunds go to the official Steam discussions or Steam Support. The developers also run a Discord, linked from the itch.io page.
  • Review copies, sponsorships or paid placements. We do not accept them. A page on this site cannot be bought.
  • Sewing patterns for real garments. This is a site about a video game called Dressmaker, not about dressmaking as a trade.
  • Requests to remove official screenshots. We link to the developers' own images rather than re-hosting them. If you are a rights holder and want a specific image removed from a page, email us and we will remove it promptly.

Before you write

A few things that let us fix issues in one pass instead of three:

  1. The exact page URL.
  2. The sentence or number that is wrong.
  3. A link to the official source - the Steam page, an official announcement, or the itch.io devlog - that shows the correct version.
  4. Your platform, if the issue is technical.

Response times

There is no support team, so please do not expect a reply in minutes. Corrections to factual errors are treated as urgent. Feature requests and suggestions are read, logged, and often turn up on the site later without a reply - that is not you being ignored.

Note: email sent to this address may be kept briefly so we can fix the issue you reported, then deleted. We do not run a newsletter and we will not add you to anything. See the privacy policy.
